chunks: And those who distribute (it) by command,
ai.seo_question: Who are the 'Al-Muqassimat' mentioned in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase is often linked to the concept of *Tawqīʿ* (divine decree), where angels act as executors of God's will in distributing sustenance (*rizq*) and affairs. This highlights the hierarchical structure of the cosmos, where divine command is mediated through angelic agents to maintain cosmic order and justice.
